testcase.name: Scenario: Open a panel compacted by a narrow application window: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:358:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a panel compacted by a narrow application window ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Manage ribbon displayed ✔ And the Insert panel displays its commands directly at the wider window size ✔ When the user narrows the application window until Insert becomes a compact panel button ✔ Then the Manage tab remains active ✔ And the part remains visible ✔ When the user clicks the compact Insert panel button ✔ Then a temporary Insert panel opens below the ribbon with its commands ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the temporary panel closes and the compact Insert button remains visible ✔ When the user maximizes the application window ✔ Then the Insert commands appear directly in the ribbon again ✔ And the part remains visible
